name: Eternal Hall (5-6)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future

disable: DC 23 Thievery check (trained) to disrupt the temporal distortions, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 21) to disperse the temporal energy

items.name: Time Press
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the hall

---

Effect Time weighs upon the creature, dealing 4d8+14 bludgeoning damage (DC 22 basic Fortitude save save). On a critical failure, the creature is Slowed 1 for 3 rounds.

text: Time distorts along this hallway, making the air feel like sludge.
